items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: this is how I met Shorty Sherock Toots Camarata, Tuss Camarada, you know.

ctx.x: You know. Ask Allen Russ Rules, you know, he -- you know, we were friends then, in Chicago, and also there at that time -- after Benny left I think it was Jimmy Dorsey and this is -- with Roy we used to go and do concerts on Sunday afternoons at the Congress Hotel, and Jimmy's band was there, and this is how I met Shorty Sherock Toots Camarata, Tuss Camarada, you know. They were in the band at this time. So I do exist.
Oh, I'm sure you are. You are documented on record labels in the record. No where else.
